subject: Request: short-term subsidy for isolated VPC pilot
messages:
From: Emma Thorpe <emma.thorpe@medify.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-04T08:12:00Z
Subject: Isolated infra subsidy for upcoming VPC pilot

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking a look. We're kicking off a 6-week evaluation next month that must run inside an isolated VPC (data residency EU) and will process PHI-adjacent documents. Our security team has flagged a few gating items: SOC 2 evidence, network egress policy, and verification that tokens and logs won't leave our subnet.

Given the extra ops for provisioning a Private/VPC pilot, can Redwood support a short-term subsidy (promo credits) to help us get through the first 90 days? Rough ask: $3k-$5k equivalent of credits and a 90-day trial extension on a dedicated private deployment so our infra team can validate throughput and auditing. We expect ~75k tokens/day peak for the first 2 weeks, then tapering.

I've attached our pilot spec and timeline (medify-pilot-specs.pdf). Procurement will need a written confirmation of what you can provision and any conditional audit evidence.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call this week.

— Emma
Emma Thorpe
Head of Product, Medify.ai
emma.thorpe@medify.ai
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Emma Thorpe <emma.thorpe@medify.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-04T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Isolated infra subsidy for upcoming VPC pilot

Hi Emma — thanks for the details and the spec. Looping in Sean (sales) and Naomi (solutions) so we can evaluate the ask and the security gating items.

Quick clarifying questions to speed review:
- Can you confirm the expected concurrent sessions and average sequence length (tokens per request)?
- Do you require a fully air-gapped deployment or just a VPC with strict egress controls and dedicated KV cache?
- Is there a signed DPA in place or do we need to route that to legal?

From Redwood side: we can provision an isolated VPC pilot and we do offer time-bound promotional credits for pilots that meet security intake milestones. To move this forward we'll need the Medify SOC 2 report (or SOC 2 Type II self-attestation) and the list of IP ranges to allow list. Please upload those to the intake form linked below so Aditya (security) can review for compliance.

I've attached an internal evidence checklist to indicate the things security will expect (evidence-checklist-internal.pdf). Once security signs off, Sean will escalate the promotional amount for approval.

Intake link: https://app.redwood.com/docs/security-intake/medify

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Manager, Sales Engineering — Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Thorpe <emma.thorpe@medify.ai>, procurement@medify.ai
Date: 2025-11-04T13:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Isolated infra subsidy for upcoming VPC pilot

Irene / team — I'm supportive of providing a pilot subsidy here; Medify looks like a good match for a Dedicated evaluation and the timelines are reasonable. If security confirms the SOC 2 attestation and egress controls, I propose we offer:
- $3,000 one-time credit applied to the pilot account
- 90-day trial extension for the isolated VPC pilot

Naomi, can you confirm the infra estimate (rough VM/GPU hours / expected burst)? Aditya — please confirm whether SOC 2 Type II attestation + the intake answers below is sufficient for a conditional approval.

Background (quoted from Irene):
> We can provision an isolated VPC pilot and offer time-bound promotional credits for pilots that meet security intake milestones.

If security approves, I'll raise this to finance to record the credit and update HubSpot (DEAL-7342).

Thanks,
Sean
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Emma Thorpe <emma.thorpe@medify.ai>, procurement@medify.ai
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-04T16:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Isolated infra subsidy for upcoming VPC pilot — conditional approval

Hi Emma — quick update and next steps.

Security (Aditya) reviewed the intake and confirms a conditional approval for a pilot subsidy, pending doc completion and standard network configuration. Based on throughput and your timeline we will:
- Apply a $3,000 promotional credit to Medify.ai's trial account (one-time).
- Grant a 90-day extension for the private/VPC pilot environment.

Conditions:
1) Medify uploads SOC 2 Type II report (or authorized attestation) and completes the security intake form at https://app.redwood.com/docs/security-intake/medify within 7 business days.
2) SSO/SCIM or account manager contact must be confirmed and the IP allow list provided before provisioning.
3) We reserve the right to revoke the extension if any of the gating items remain open after 14 days.

I've attached a short credit-approval letter you can return signed for procurement (credit-approval-letter.pdf). For speed, we can also DocuSign this — link: https://docusign.redwood.com/Sign/XYZ-123

I'll kick off the finance ticket once we get a signed acknowledgement or a DocuSign completion. Happy to schedule a 30-minute kickoff call with Naomi and our infra team to walk through provisioning.

Best regards,
Irene
Manager, Sales Engineering — Redwood Inference
